scenarios.name: Marseille Corridor - Golfe du Lion & Calanques Sanctuary
scenarios.description: Surveillance sector covering Grand Port Maritime de Marseille (GPMM), Frioul archipelago, and Parc National des Calanques. Detects illicit unflagged bunker barges and dark speedcraft.

scenarios.name: Oran Corridor - Baie d'Oran & Habibas Marine Reserve
scenarios.description: Surveillance corridor spanning Port d'Oran, Arzew LNG export channel, and the ecologically sensitive Habibas Islands nature reserve.
